traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Love and value meet imagination. Heightened artistic sensibility and romantic idealism. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Seeing what you want to see in love, idealizing people, and the disillusionment that follows. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.meaning: Connection and imagination reach full awareness and face each other: culmination, objectivity, fulfillment or confrontation.

business: Friction in this area. Real artistic gifts; guard against unrealistic expectations of people and outcomes.
shadow: Indulgence and vanity collides with illusion and escapism; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: A confrontation builds; the other side comes fully into view.
arcSeparating: The standoff resolves into balance or a split.
